title: MySQL variables
description: Configuration variables for MySQL 8.x database server and client.

MYSQL_VERSION.description: Specific version of MySQL to install (e.g. '8.4.11', '8.0.36', 'latest').

MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Root password for MySQL server administration.

MYSQL_DATABASE.description: Initial database to create upon setup (e.g., 'openedx').

MYSQL_USER.description: Database user account to create and grant permissions.

MYSQL_PASSWORD.description: Password for the database user account.

MYSQL_DATA_DIR.description: Custom directory where MySQL storage engine databases are kept.

MYSQL_REMOTE_URL.description: Connection string or URL for external MySQL host (e.g. 'mysql://user:pass@remote-host:3306/db'). If set, local MySQL installation can be skipped.

MYSQL_INSTALL_LOCAL.description: Whether to install and provision a local MySQL database server instance.

MYSQL_SKIP_LOCAL_INSTALL.description: Explicitly bypass local MySQL server setup when utilizing a managed remote database.

MYSQL_CHARACTER_SET.description: Default server and database character set.

MYSQL_COLLATION.description: Default server and database collation sequence.
